name: XlXmlLoadOption
description: Specifies how Excel opens the XML data file.

constants.name: xlXmlLoadPromptUser
constants.description: Prompts the user to choose how to open the file.

constants.name: xlXmlLoadOpenXml
constants.description: Opens the XML data file. The contents of the file will be flattened.

constants.name: xlXmlLoadImportToList
constants.description: Places the contents of the XML data file in an XML table.

constants.name: xlXmlLoadMapXml
constants.description: Displays the schema of the XML data file in the XML Structure task pane.
